media.alt: An iOS app update completed by Codex with asset, signing, Simulator, test, and device-build work

title: Benchmark a Medium-Reasoning Agent on a Full iOS Delivery Loop
summary: techsage reports using a medium-reasoning Codex run to prepare app icons, add an in-app selector, update signing for sharing extensions, run tests with Simulator computer use, and build to a physical iPhone in 15 minutes. An iOS team can benchmark a representative end-to-end task before defaulting every change to its most expensive reasoning tier.
takeaway: Benchmark model tiers on a change spanning assets, UI, signing, automated tests, Simulator verification, and a device build before reserving maximum reasoning for every task.
